rows.text: Address headed as that of the President of the Constitutional Council 'au Président de la République à l'occasion de la cérémonie d'investiture au Palais de l'Elysée le 16 mai 2007', recalling that on 6 May 2007 'vous avez recueilli 18.983.138 voix' and that the Council proclaimed him elected 'le 10 mai dernier'.

The address states: 'vous devenez ainsi le sixième Président de la Cinquième République' and 'A compter de ce jour, et pour la durée de votre mandat, vous incarnez la France, symbolisez la République et représentez l'ensemble des Français.'

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-23 only (Président de la République, 1 January 1990 to the 7 September 2026 cutoff). Election rounds, the Constitutional Council's proclamation, its publication, the investiture ceremony, a stated start of term, an outer limit and any stated end stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Prime ministers, ministers, party offices and the President of the Senate's interim office are excluded.
